nom: Biore Pore Unclogging Scrub With Salicylic Acid

avis.titre: Average Daily Scrub — Okay for Basic Use, No Major Changes Over TimeAverage Daily Scrub — Okay for Basic Use, No Major C
avis.texte: ⭐️⭐️⭐️☆☆ Nothing special, works okay but didn’t change much for me I’ve been using this scrub consistently for a few months now, and overall it’s been pretty average for my skin. Performance: It does an okay job with basic cleansing and light exfoliation, but I didn’t notice a big improvement in clogged pores or skin texture over time. I was hoping for more noticeable results with consistent use, but things have stayed fairly the same. Breakouts / blemishes: Even with regular use, I still get blemishes. It hasn’t really helped prevent breakouts in a meaningful way for me personally. Texture & feel: The scrub itself is fine—nothing harsh or irritating, but also nothing that stands out as especially effective or unique. Scent: Mild and not overpowering, which is nice for daily use. Overall: It’s an okay basic scrub if you just want something simple, but based on my experience using it for months, I didn’t see major improvements in skin clarity or congestion. Probably not something I would repurchase.
This facial scrub is 10 out of 10. It left my face feeling light and I could tell my pores opened right away!

Give it 1-2 Months. I started using the Biore Unclogging Scrub 3-4 times per week (dove bar soap other days) 2 months ago. My pores have visibly shrunk and I have significantly less blackheads. No issues with acne or any other issues. 10/10 recommend this product
This product is great for large pores and black heads. Bior'e has a better heated pore unclogging scrub, but I have not been able to find it.
Great feeling on your skin I'm not sure about the unclogging part but I've bought it twice already it's a good price too

Excellent scrub for oily, combination and even normal skin as it cleans really well,leaving one fresh and clear of impurities. It has a light menthol tingly effect after washing. Biore is a trustworthy brand so would definitely buy it again.

I've used apricot scrub in the past by St.Ives and thought it was the same texture. I like that this has tiny beads and goes on soft and forms a good later with a little bit of water (I was in a hurry and had applied directly on my face with no water) so if you want to save some product follow instructions lol and apply to wet face first. Also, I have blemishes on my forehead but after using this product a few times, I noticed that skin has lightened somewhat on that area. My primary use is to deep clean and feel fresh. There you have it...nice, fresh, clean skin.

I do not have acne but I use this Biore Face Scrub with Salicylic Acid as it thoroughly removes dirt from my oily skin. It doesn't dry out my skin and I find it helpful to use it before going to bed. Works best with lukewarm water.

avis.titre: Great product. It’s a must buy!
avis.texte: This product was amazing just a little dab created so much foam. As soon as I worked it into my skin I felt a cooling sensation of the micro beads. After washing it off my skin felt squeaky clean and it maintained that cooling sensation for awhile. I would buy it again. I am a satisfied customer.

Great cleaning and the best pleasing scent. My face feels so clean and fresh. I've been using this for 2 years and giving this out as gifts to my friends and family members. It is just so great that you want to share to all of your loved ones. Highly recommended

avis.titre: Very refreshing and a good for male and female skin care.
avis.texte: Used this product to begin a more deep cleaning routine for my face and pores. Very creamy and light texture with super small tiny rocks that feel great as they scrub your skin and clean your pores. Face feels fresh and minty cool after use.
Love this !! Strong smell to it camer super fast .. Very satisfied

Love this cleanser!! It gives my face a fresh feeling, like toothpaste and mouthwash give your mouth. It also left my skin feeling softer and smoother since the initial use. The beads are great. I have been repurchasing ever since!

I tried switching up my products to help with a breakout. After reading the reviews, I decided to try this out. I have used it for about a month and am fed up. It does nothing for pimples, and it does not even clean deeply. I would go over my face with witch hazel right after using this and clean up so much that was left behind. It doesn't foam at all, and as you can see in the picture, it is almost greasy. It's a pain to rinse off and does not leave my face feeling clean or smooth.

This is a good cleaner for sensitive skin but I was hoping and expecting it to be a little grittier, especially due to its marketing of being a “free your pores scrub”. It’s very soft and gentle and I was just hoping it would really scrub and cleanse my skin. It’s an ok product for me that I’ll use until it’s gone, but likely won’t buy again. I’m including a few photos of the product just to provide a closer look of what to expect - hope that helps!

I wanted to give a try to some new different scrub and read reviews in Amazon. Today used this scrub for the first time and instantly regretted . My face got red after literally applying . I had to rinse off immediately and apply soothing cream.
